_doc: Map 0 (Crossroads Inn) settings not in the generic tables. power: the cellar lever (T&C M2, T-027). exfil: the campaign beacon (T-033): lights when round `round` starts, stays open window_seconds, then again every retry_rounds rounds; a vote at the beacon leaves for `target` through cutscene `cutscene` (data/gravelight/campaign.json). position/yaw in the map frame (yaw 0 = the beacon's front faces -Z). opens_zone: that zone's doors open for free when the beacon lights, so the exfil is always reachable.
